title: Four Horsemen - Feature Documentary - Official Version
summary: An independent feature documentary in which 23 economists, advisers and financiers discuss how the financial system works and what a more just economic model might look like. It covers money creation, debt and the aftermath of the financial crisis.
why: Mentioned as a one-package overview of heterodox views on money creation and debt, though some find it unsurprising.

quote.text: goes into these topics at length, especially money creation
